Package com.nexuslink.security.cert

Class CertificateImporter

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.security.cert.CertificateImporter
public final class CertificateImporter extends Object
Imports certificates and private keys from PKCS#12 (.p12/.pfx) or JKS keystore bundles. Decodes every alias into a CertificateImporter.Entry (the leaf certificate, its chain, and the private key when present), so a bundle can be browsed and its entries added to the trust store. Uses only the JDK KeyStore API; round-trips against CertificateExporter under test.
